subject: Request: remove single conversation from telemetry logs (RID-VERDE-210)
messages:
From: Jacob Sims <jacob.sims@acmehealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, support@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: remove conversation RID-VERDE-210 from logs

Hi team,

We discovered a conversation thread containing sensitive patient identifiers that was inadvertently captured in your telemetry logs. The thread reference is RID-VERDE-210. Per our data handling agreement and our internal policy, we need this single conversation removed from any telemetry, analytics, and retained logs.

What we need from Redwood:
- Confirmation you can remove the thread from all telemetry and audit indexes tied to our account
- An ETA for completion and a brief description of the steps you will take
- A post-action artifact or attestation we can store for our records (redacted proof is fine)

I am copying our Security Ops alias (support@acmehealth.com) and Legal Ops as required. Please let me know what verification you need from our side.

Thanks,
Jacob
Jacob Sims
Head of Security Ops, Acme Health

Attachment: acme_deletion_request_RID-VERDE-210.eml (request from customer)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jacob Sims <jacob.sims@acmehealth.com>, support@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-05-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: remove conversation RID-VERDE-210 from logs

Ben / Naomi — looping you in to own the customer request.

Quick context: Acme Health reports a single conversation (RID-VERDE-210) that includes sensitive identifiers and wants it removed from telemetry and audit indexes. They want an ETA and an artifact after deletion.

Ben: can you confirm account-level approvals and whether there are any active legal holds?
Naomi: please advise on the privacy workflow and what evidence we can generate that satisfies HIPAA-friendly audit needs without exposing additional data.

I expect this to be handled as a targeted exclusion rather than a retention policy change. If we need legal sign-off, flag that.

Thanks — I can coordinate the customer comms once we have a plan and ETA.

—Irene
Irene Choi
Manager, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jacob Sims <jacob.sims@acmehealth.com>, Legal Ops <legal@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: remove conversation RID-VERDE-210 from logs

Thanks Irene.

Summary of privacy checks / required items:
- We can perform a targeted excision of a single conversation record from our telemetry indexes and from active analytics caches.
- Deletion from immutable cold archives (where we store raw audit captures for N days) requires a documented authorization from an account owner and a Legal Ops acknowledgement if the request intersects a regulatory hold.

Please ask Acme to provide:
1) Confirmation that the requester (Jacob Sims) is authorized to submit data-removal requests for Acme Health (short email from an account owner is fine)
2) Any internal ticket id or legal hold exception if this thread has been referenced in an investigation

Planned steps once authorized:
- Validate the thread identifier across telemetry, per-route logs, and the prefix KV cache indices (T+0)
- Submit a targeted job to remove associated index pointers and mark the record as excised (this does not recreate the raw message blob)
- Run a follow-up verification job and produce a redacted audit extract showing removed pointers and job run ids

Estimated timeline after receiving authorization: 72 hours for completion and artifact generation.

I will start prepping the excision job and the redacted artifact template; hold until Ben confirms account approval.

-Naomi
Privacy & Compliance — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jacob Sims <jacob.sims@acmehealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-20T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: remove conversation RID-VERDE-210 from logs

Jacob — thanks for the clear request and for including Legal Ops. Acme confirms Jacob is authorized via a short reply from Amelia Park (Acme account owner) earlier today (attached to this thread). We're good to proceed.

Action plan (SOP tailored):
1) Authorization validated by Ben Carter (Account Lead) and recorded in SUP-4482.
2) Naomi will run the targeted excision job (index pointer removal + cache invalidation).
3) Engineering will run verification queries and produce a redacted audit extract (audit_extract_RID-VERDE-210.pdf).
4) We will share the redacted artifact and a signed attestation once complete.

ETA: completion and artifact in ~72 hours from now (by 2026-05-23T15:30:00-07:00). If anything changes we will update you.

Cc: Grace O'Connor for tracking in the customer success playbook.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments: audit_extract_RID-VERDE-210.pdf (redacted proof), SUP-4482 (internal ticket link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-4482)
